name: Pixel wipe
what: A transition made of square pixels: blobs grow from a few spots until the frame is one colour, then shrink away blob by blob to reveal the words (or the next shot) - stepped like a pixel animation.

learned_from.what: pixelated blue blobs growing over the frame, then shrinking away to reveal a quote

motion: 24 steps over 26 f (power1.inOut spacing), 10 f full, back over 30 f
